scope: All original CN variants and their QCP migrations, plus existing constructed variants and archived input/result evidence
source_match_policy: Exact source/goal/input hashes when available; weaker manifest/case associations labelled explicitly. Never move a PASS, counterexample or measurement to a changed contract/input silently.
unknown_policy: Preserve UNKNOWN, errors, residual manual obligations, missing measurements and prepared-only inputs. No invented PASS or zero resource usage.
legacy_generators: Obsolete seven-slot generators and quota design removed. Existing data, inputs, results, validators and replay tools retained; generators remain recoverable from Git history.
variant_identity: A variant fixes both implementation and specification. Either or both may change; changed implementation or spec creates a new variant. CN and QCP are language representations of the corresponding variant with alignment scope recorded.

execution_policy.formal_verification_input_scope: Universal over inputs satisfying the variant precondition; not repeated for each finite test case.
execution_policy.test_cases_per_variant: Multiple applicable cases; reuse existing cases and record missing coverage explicitly.
execution_policy.test_applicability: Evaluate against this variant precondition. Outside-precondition cases must be marked separately and cannot establish an implementation bug under the contract.
execution_policy.resource_accounting: Record verification time, peak memory and actual tokens once per variant/tool. Record test time, peak memory and actual tokens per variant/input/tool; aggregate with case counts. Never multiply verification metrics by test count.
execution_policy.reuse_key: Implementation, specification, dependencies, tool/version/configuration and proof context must match for verification reuse; test reuse additionally requires matching input.
execution_policy.qcp_completion: QCP is the universal-verification version of the evaluated workflow. Reuse matching native VC generation and completed proof receipts; account for proof generation, compilation, assumption audit and independent kernel replay. Native auto success alone must be labelled automatic-stage-only if full proof evidence is absent. Count model tokens only when a model is actually invoked.
execution_policy.historical_repeats: Preserve old repeated measurements as historical observations; no new mandatory repeated verification runs.
execution_policy.non_primary_variants: Testing only; no required CN/QCP formal verification. Retain existing formal results as optional historical evidence.
execution_policy.primary_verification_reuse: Reuse matching archived CN/QCP proof and verification receipts first; run only missing verification. No requirement to reprove completed matching primary variants.

test_pipeline.official_result: The complete staged result; automatic-only statistics are diagnostics, not final benchmark accuracy.
test_pipeline.itp_trigger: Unresolved test VCs after execution, unless a matching checked proof/refutation receipt is reusable. Already decided cases do not require redundant ITP.
test_pipeline.itp_positive: Prove every required unresolved obligation before a final PASS.
test_pipeline.itp_negative: A checked refutation of a required VC with a satisfiable admitted entry establishes FAIL.
test_pipeline.itp_trust: Compile exact goal/proof sources, audit assumptions and independently kernel-check. Retain proof and input/source hashes.
test_pipeline.unknown: Unresolved cases remain UNKNOWN and pipeline-incomplete; do not hide them.
test_pipeline.error_scoring: Keep raw ERROR. Count only the explicitly approved readable-memory error for emp-precondition dereference variants as expected test outcomes; unrelated errors are not successful detections.
test_pipeline.formal_scope: Test-specific VC checking is part of testing and does not impose universal formal verification on every variant. Main-program verification is still once per group and reused.
test_pipeline.resource_accounting: Include execution plus ITP generation/repair, compilation, assumption audit and kernel check. Count failed attempts and shared stage work once. Report unknown time/memory/token measurements as null, never zero.
test_pipeline.model_policy: Use requested gpt-6.1-sol for model-assisted proof authoring when invoked; preserve actual model and token receipts. Unmetered conversation authoring is reported as missing telemetry, not zero tokens.
